dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from a broad thoracic region toward a significantly constricted posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slightly asymmetrical convex curvature along the lateral margins, with the left margin exhibiting a more pronounced outward arc than the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to mature white skin tone with specular highlights concentrated along the sagittal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark longitudinal linear mark located on the posterior half of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle topological depression along the central dorsal axis in the posterior region, corresponding with a dark pigment mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark linear scar or marking situated on the midline of the posterior dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible dark circular blowhole aperture located at the anterior apex of the visible dorsal mass.
